strings.(시원한 바람을 맞으며 앉아있던 발드릭 앞에 여러 사람이 나타난다.): (Several people approach Valdrick as he sits enjoying the cool breeze.)
strings.모두 오랜만이야. 여기까지 와준 걸 보면 내가 잘못된 건 아닌가 봐. 하: It's been a while, everyone. Since you've all come this far, I suppose I wasn't mistaken. Hahaha.
strings.지스카드 아우님. 반가워!: Ziskad, my boy. Good to see you!
Yes, Sir Valdrick. Let's save the sparring for another time.
Hahaha, I'll think about it. And Shynic, little one. It's been a while.
strings.응, 오랜만이네. 오늘은 좀 재미있는 거야?: It has. Is today going to be fun?
It's fun for me. Not sure about you.
And old Atkina, thank you for last time.
Not at all. It was only possible because you were there.
strings.아저씨, 오랜만이에요. 그냥 오면 섭섭할 것 같아서 내가 선물을 준비했지: It's been a while, old man. I thought arriving empty-handed would disappoint you, so I brought a gift. People need their meat, after all.
strings.(하얀 옷을 입은 차가운 인상의 소녀가 손짓하자 하늘에서 커다란 얼음 조: (A cold-looking girl in white gestures, and an enormous block of ice descends from the sky.)
How did you know I love meat? You brought so much!
Even Weiss would be baffled if someone said you didn't like meat.
strings.…나는 네가 고기를 먹지 않는 다는 말을 믿지 않는다…, 발드릭…. 이러: "...I do not believe you would abstain from meat... Valdrick..." Like that.
strings.(하얀 옷을 입은 소녀가 목소리를 낮게 깔면서 바이스 흉내를 낸다.): (The girl in white lowers her voice to imitate Weiss.)
Hahaha! You do a wonderful impression of Weiss, Lady Io.
I should. After what he put me through, I could hardly forget. Sigh...
strings.아저씨, 이제 아가씨라 부르지 말고 이름 불러요. 아버지께 신세져서 예의: Stop calling me "Lady," old man. Use my name. It's been hundreds of years since you started being formal because you owed my father a debt.
strings.벌써 그렇게 됐네. 어르신의 은혜를 받아서 고마워서 그랬던 건데. 그러면: Has it been that long? I was grateful for his kindness. All right, I'll just call you Io. And I suppose I should do the same for Medea...
strings.후아. 이제 좀 편하네. 고마워요, 아저씨. 그리고! 그 고기 꼭! 평소: Phew. That's better. Thank you, old man. And make sure you share that meat with the people who look after you! It's mountain goat raised in the pure air of the snowfields.
strings.그리고 데보라의 얼음으로 숙성까지 시켰으니 입에 넣는 순간 바로 녹을 걸: I even aged it in Deborah's ice, so it'll melt the moment it touches your tongue.
I sent some to Tartarus for you too, Shynic.
strings.다른 분들도 섭섭하지 않게 미르에게 부탁해해서 보내드릴 예정이예요. 아드: And I'll ask Mir to send some to everyone else, so no one feels left out. I'm sorry about you, Atkina. You don't eat...
I sent some to Medea too, though I don't know if she'll accept it.
I'll pass it along. She listens to me.
strings.그럼 부탁드릴게요. 하여튼 모두 반가워요. 그동안 나 잊지 않았죠? 거봐: Thank you. Anyway, it's good to see everyone. You haven't forgotten me, have you? See? As long as we don't die, we'll meet again someday.
strings.(이오가 환하게 웃으며 모두와 악수를 하더니 샤이닉만은 두 팔을 벌려 껴: (Io smiles brightly and shakes everyone's hand, then opens her arms to embrace Shynic.)
You're so small, Shynic. Perfect for hugging.
strings.키가 막 자라려고 할 때, 이렇게 돼서 억울한 걸. 후우, 죽어서 다시: It's unfair. This happened just when I was about to have a growth spurt. Sigh. I can't even die and be reborn. Anyway, Valdrick, why do you use everyone else's name but call me "little one"?
strings.응? 그게 왜? 꼬맹이가 꼬맹이인게 어때서?: Huh? What's wrong with that? A little one's a little one.
Why have I wasted hundreds of years telling you? You're still too stupid to understand.
strings.언니, 그런 건 신경쓰지 말아요. 아저씨가 바보인 건 세상 사람이 다 아: Don't worry about it, Shynic. Everyone in the world knows he's an idiot.
strings.하하하, 이오가 그런 거면 그런 거겠지? 그런데 메디아는?: Hahaha! If Io says so, I suppose it must be true. But where's Medea?
I believe she needs some time, Sir Valdrick.
Wait until Medea tells you herself, Shynic.
strings.(발드릭이 손을 들어 어떤 장소를 향해 뻗는다.): (Valdrick raises a hand and points toward somewhere in the distance.)
strings.저기, 저쪽에 바이스 놈이 있을 거야. 그 놈이 뭘 하려는지는 모르겠지만: Weiss should be over there. I don't know what he's planning, but his power keeps growing.
I understand what you mean, but the time isn't right yet.
I know, old man. What I'm saying is...
strings.거 말로 길게 설명하기 어렵네. 그러니까, 때가 되면 다 같이 박살내러: It's hard to explain in words. So when the time comes, let's all go beat him to a pulp!!
